name: ctxprune
description: Context compression for Claude Code: rewrites big tool outputs into a shorter form before Claude reads them, without dropping content

plugins.name: ctxprune
plugins.description: Rewrites big Bash, PowerShell, Grep and MCP tool outputs into a shorter form without dropping content. Uses the installed ctxprune, else uvx.

plugins.name: ctxprune-safe
plugins.description: Rewrites big Bash, PowerShell, Grep and MCP tool outputs into a shorter form without dropping content (repeated lines counted, JSON record lists as rows, escaped JSON shown as text). Stdlib Python, no model, no network; fails open.
